question: In which Indian state will you find the Borail Wildlife Sanctuary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Borail Wildlife Sanctuary is in the Cach**ar district of Assam__.

 __
 
• The sanctuary includes North Cachar Reserve Forest and Barel Reserve Forest.
 
• It is famous for tropical moist evergreen and semi-evergreen forests.
